prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.resolvePermissions = function(role, parents, grants)
Behavior: Collect the named role's grants and every parent role's grants, deduplicate, and sort. Reject an unknown role, unknown parent reached in the chain, or inheritance cycle. Empty parent marks the root.
Visible example: editor granting write and inheriting viewer granting read resolves to [read,write].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: exports.resolvePermissions=(role,parents,grants)=>{const seen=new Set,out=new Set;while(role!==''){if(!(role in parents)&&!(role in grants)||seen.has(role))return null;seen.add(role);for(const p of grants[role]||[])out.add(p);role=parents[role]||''}return[...out].sort()}
